profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software engineer with a masters degree in computer science and 10+ years of experience. Currently working on projects involving C# and React.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked on the GUI component of a trade order management system using C#.
•	Devised a fair trade-allocation algorithm for distributing acquired shares among multiple trade orders.
•	Designed and developed a new hierarchical object model for grouping trades.
•	Developed a scalable process to automate trade input event generation for build validation. This process resulted in a 93% reduction in memory usage over the legacy code base.
•	Achieved a 50% performance gain in archiving of EOD trade positions by improving thread management and process scheduling.
•	Implemented automated pre-deployment validation for the SecDB trading platform leading to substantial improvement in stability of trading environment.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: •	Developed an ad-hoc reporting infrastructure for the GSAM Compliance department using Java Struts. This infrastructure reduced the team's technology support effort by 2 hours daily.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
•	Implemented a log shipping process across Singapore and Dubai offices to provide failover capability for a mission-critical database in Singapore.
•	Developed an app for export certificate generation for a Windows CE-based handheld device.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: •	Designed a mobile application for a Symbol MC3000 handheld terminal. This was used to conduct Stock Take and Serial Number Tracking. Involved extensive use of remote database access and live data synchronization.

educations.schoolName: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani
